fixtures.describes: Lög um vexti og verðtryggingu nr. 38/2001 — 'vaxtalög'. Nine chapters, fifteen temporary provisions numbered in roman, one repealed article. The act whose short name is nowhere in its own title, which is what Act.aliases exists for.

Jarðalög nr. 81/2004. Lettered articles inserted by amendment (7. gr. a–d, 10. gr. a), per-article headings, an annex, five repealed articles. The lettered articles are the shape that lib/legal-citations.ts silently failed to extract before 2026-08-31.
